mapper.select: SELECT act01_account_code_id AS account_code_id , act01_company_id AS company_id , act01_attribute_cd AS attribute_code , f_cdnm('AccountAttributeCode', act01_attribute_cd, act01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS attribute_name , act01_account_cd AS account_code , CASE WHEN COALESCE(act01_use_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '(사용X)' ELSE '' END || act01_account_nm AS account_name , CASE WHEN COALESCE(act01_use_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '(사용X)' ELSE '' END || act01_account_nm2 AS account_name2 FROM act01_account_code WHERE act01_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(act01_use_yn , 'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(act01_slip_yn, 'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(act01_attribute_cd, '%') LIKE #{attributeCode} AND UPPER(CONCAT(act01_account_cd, act01_account_nm, act01_account_enm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY act01_attribute_cd, act01_print_seq
mapper.sql: a.act01_account_code_id AS account_code_id , a.act01_company_id AS company_id , a.act01_account_cd AS account_code , a.act01_account_nm AS account_name , a.act01_account_nm2 AS account_name2 , a.act01_account_enm AS account_e_name , a.act01_parent_cd AS parent_code , (SELECT act01_account_cd || ' ' || CASE WHEN COALESCE(act01_use_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '(사용X)' ELSE '' END || act01_account_nm FROM act01_account_code WHERE act01_company_id = a.act01_company_id AND act01_account_cd = a.act01_parent_cd LIMIT 1) AS parent_name , a.act01_attribute_cd AS attribute_code , f_cdnm('AccountAttributeCode', a.act01_attribute_cd, a.act01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS attribute_name , a.act01_drcr_type AS drcr_type , f_cdnm('DrcrType', a.act01_drcr_type, a.act01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS drcr_name , a.act01_slip_yn AS slip_yn , a.act01_print_yn AS print_yn , a.act01_use_yn AS use_yn , a.act01_fss_yn AS fss_yn , a.act01_fss_account_nm AS fss_account_name , a.act01_fss_slip_yn AS fss_slip_yn , a.act01_print_seq AS print_seq , a.act01_content AS content
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO act01_account_code (act01_account_code_id, act01_company_id, act01_account_cd, act01_account_nm, act01_account_nm2, act01_account_enm, act01_parent_cd, act01_attribute_cd, act01_drcr_type, act01_slip_yn, act01_use_yn, act01_content, act01_fss_yn, act01_fss_account_nm, act01_fss_slip_yn, act01_print_yn, act01_print_seq) VALUES (#{accountCodeId}, #{companyId}, #{req.accountCode}, #{req.accountName}, #{req.accountName2}, #{req.accountEName}, #{req.parentCode}, #{req.attributeCode}, #{req.drcrType}, #{req.slipYn}, #{req.useYn}, #{req.content}, #{req.fssYn}, #{req.fssAccountName}, #{req.fssSlipYn}, #{req.printYn}, #{req.printSeq})
mapper.update: UPDATE act01_account_code SET act01_account_cd = #{req.accountCode}, act01_account_nm = #{req.accountName}, act01_account_nm2 = #{req.accountName2}, act01_account_enm = #{req.accountEName}, act01_parent_cd = #{req.parentCode}, act01_attribute_cd = #{req.attributeCode}, act01_drcr_type = #{req.drcrType}, act01_slip_yn = #{req.slipYn}, act01_use_yn = #{req.useYn}, act01_content = #{req.content}, act01_fss_yn = #{req.fssYn}, act01_fss_account_nm = #{req.fssAccountName}, act01_fss_slip_yn = #{req.fssSlipYn}, act01_print_yn = #{req.printYn}, act01_print_seq = #{req.printSeq} WHERE act01_account_code_id = #{req.accountCodeId} AND act01_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE act_list ( act01_account_cd, act01_parent_cd, act01_level, act01_path, act01_cycle ) AS ( SELECT a.act01_account_cd , a.act01_parent_cd , 0 , ARRAY[a.act01_account_cd::text] , false FROM act01_account_code a WHERE 1=1 AND act01_company_id = #{companyId} AND act01_parent_cd = '0' AND COALESCE(a.act01_use_yn,'false') = 'true' UNION ALL SELECT a.act01_account_cd , a.act01_parent_cd , b.act01_level + 1 , array_append(b.act01_path, a.act01_account_cd::text) , a.act01_account_cd = ANY(b.act01_path) FROM act01_account_code a , act_list b WHERE 1=1 AND a.act01_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.act01_parent_cd = b.act01_account_cd AND COALESCE(a.act01_use_yn,'false') = 'true' AND NOT act01_cycle ) SELECT a.act01_account_code_id AS account_code_id , a.act01_company_id AS company_id , a.act01_account_cd AS account_code , a.act01_account_nm AS account_name , a.act01_account_nm2 AS account_name2 , a.act01_parent_cd AS parent_code , a.act01_slip_yn AS slip_yn , act_list.act01_level AS level FROM act_list INNER JOIN act01_account_code a ON ( a.act01_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.act01_account_cd = act_list.act01_account_cd ) ORDER BY act_list.act01_path

WITH RECURSIVE act_list ( act01_account_cd, act01_parent_cd, act01_level ) AS ( SELECT act01_account_cd , act01_parent_cd , 0 FROM act01_account_code WHERE act01_company_id = #{companyId} AND act01_account_cd = #{accountCode} AND COALESCE(act01_use_yn,'false') = 'true' UNION ALL SELECT a.act01_account_cd , a.act01_parent_cd , b.act01_level + 1 FROM act01_account_code a , act_list b WHERE a.act01_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.act01_account_cd = b.act01_parent_cd AND COALESCE(a.act01_use_yn,'false') = 'true' ) SELECT FROM act_list INNER JOIN act01_account_code a ON ( a.act01_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.act01_account_cd = act_list.act01_account_cd ) ORDER BY act_list.act01_level DESC
